name: Nightruth #1 Yami no Tobira
original_name: ナイトゥルース闇の扉
source:
Yami no Tobira is an adventure game about a group of five children (two boys and three girls) who investigate paranormal phenomena and get strange powers.

Game begins with one girl seeing another girl die from spontaneous combustion. Main character learns about this story from TV and starts investigation together with friends.
